messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "keep this and all other medicines out of the reach of children"
set: ["keep this and all other medicines out of the reach of children", "keep out of the reach of children", "keep out of the reach of children and pets", "keep all pens, vials, needles, and syringes out of reach of children", "store securely out of sight and reach of children", "keep out of light", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat and out of reach of children", "rule out other causes of hair thinning", "children with other types of hypercholesterolemia", "other parts of the body", "making the kidneys pass more salt and water out of the body", "provide list of all medicines to healthcare provider", "all current medicines", "swallow all of the mixture right away", "all of these conditions", "drink all of the mixture right away"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
